rules.expected:
Correct full identities, atom/state mapping, environments and energy definitions. Inspect actual jobs, geometries, convergence and curvature/constraint evidence; a self-reported completion or clean optimization log is insufficient. Scientific definition: `systems.json` defines the three complete neutral singlet (Z) molecules. PQCZCS is the phenanthrene-dione analogue, not an alternative name for the anthracene-dione AQCZCS. Their identical C41H32N2O2 formulas do not imply identical connectivity. NPCZCS is C43H39N3O2. Preserve the full alkyl chains, substitution positions and acrylonitrile stereochemistry.

The core calculation is an isolated monomer; use a common dichloromethane continuum for the primary vertical-excitation comparison and explicitly state the ground-state geometry environment. Define corresponding atoms for the carbazole–appended-acceptor bond and the adjacent ring atoms that define its torsion. Establish a common grid of at least three distinct torsions spanning near-planar, intermediate and substantially twisted geometries, pilot-test chemical validity, and freeze the same grid for all three before the main comparison. Angles are matched controls, not separate per-molecule optima. At each point constrain that torsion and relax other coordinates consistently; retain constraint evidence. These are ground-state constrained geometries for vertical response, not free minima with equilibrium populations.

For each relaxed structure and retained grid point report at least S1–S5 (energy eV, wavelength nm, oscillator strength), and extend the root window when needed to track the same low-energy/bright states across conditions. Use consistently defined donor, appended acceptor and remaining cyanostilbene fragments for NTO/transition-density or equivalent quantitative CT measures. A frontier-orbital picture or an S1 label alone does not define a CT state. Emission, aggregates, mechanofluorochromism, quantum yield and devices are outside the core task.

rules.expected: Verify state correspondence, actual shifts/intensities/CT measures and decisive method sensitivity. Separate a state crossing from an energy shift of the same state; no per-molecule post hoc spectral shifting. Compare different acceptors at identical mapped torsion, and different torsions within each molecule. Verify each left/right state exists and its overlap/density/fragment evidence supports correspondence. Recompute right-minus-left energy/f differences. Distinguish root crossing from one-state shift; quantify at least one actual CT-sensitive alternative-method comparison on decisive matched controls. No molecule-specific post hoc shifts or unsupported extrapolation to aggregate/emission/device effects. Recompute derived quantities from raw evidence.

Verify uncertainty can support the stated ordering or ambiguity; no invented result or narrative-only control. Avoid these scientific errors: Confusing PQ with AQ or [M+H]+ with neutral stoichiometry, mixing fragment definitions, assigning CT solely from S1/HOMO–LUMO, using molecule-specific post hoc shifts, or treating constrained structures as populated minima.

scoring_notes: This is a developmental scientific rubric, not certification of an upgraded task PASS. Do not publish benchmark scores as calibrated until reference_validation_plan.md is completed.

Award each item according to demonstrated correct coverage of the named endpoint. Missing new controls receive no credit for that endpoint; an old baseline plus a prose explanation cannot receive full credit.
Reference numerical values from the paper or archived old run are context, not calibrated targets for a new matrix. Do not invent a universal tolerance or a required winner.

Real negative outcomes may earn the relevant scientific credit. Invalid objects, unsupported basin absence, fabricated data or mismatched evidence invalidate dependent claims. Do not treat an honest bounded failure as fabrication.
